title: Skating In The Mall
content: My MallWorld has an ice skating rink on the bottom level. I have been in three malls in real life that had that feature, so maybe that's why my dream world has one. I went skating there last night, and was surprised to see Princess Diana there with her entourage. I thought they were her security detail. They were all tall, good-looking men. I hope she is happily ice skating somewhere. She looked really beautiful in her skating outfit. Celebrities often visit my Mall, alive or not!
